title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router: attackers can run commands on it
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 28 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access. The severity score is critical (9.8).
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.
The product faces the internet or gives remote access.

category.label: Routers, cameras and devices
category.why: Routers, cameras and recorders are often forgotten and rarely updated.
category.doThis: Update it or replace it. Never leave its admin page open to the internet.

summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. CISA set Nov 28, 2026 as the deadline for US federal agencies. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
